answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Like a quill recording immutable state transitions, the network anchors identity to economic risk. An attacker attempting to isolate their node on a virtual island must acquire a majority of total staked assets, a prohibitive barrier akin to buying an entire orchard to steal one fruit. The cost of such an attack is proportional to the total value secured, ensuring agent integrity through stake loss.
